name: Den Shorka
source:
The familiar trio of heroes, Semyon, Shurik, and El, will find themselves in a whirlwind of events once more and get into tricky situations. This time, the very existence of the camp is at stake. Only time will tell whether they can save Sovyonok from this nightmare.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3699179691]Steam[/url]]
translation:
熟悉的英雄三人组，谢苗、舒里克和埃尔，将再次陷入事件旋风并陷入棘手的境地。这一次，营地的生存岌岌可危。只有时间才能证明他们能否将索维诺克从这场噩梦中拯救出来。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3699179691]Steam[/url]]
